lessons: Tonight contradicted the guide: RG went 3-0 with no fliers, Brimstone Volley and Blasphemous Act, beating my WG 2-0, while both WR decks went 1-2 instead of the 3-0 model.
My WG had only two evasive threats, Voiceless Spirit and Orchard Spirit, short of the guide's three, and Cloistered Youth at pick 6 never made the deck; skip it for a flier.
Keep at least eight Forests for the three GG Somberwald Spiders; my 10 Forest, 7 Plains build went 2-1, as the guide advised.
Against the green Somberwald Spider and Spider Spawning deck, my ground-based Zombie bodies, such as Typhoid Rats and Diregraf Ghoul, lost 0-2, so value flyers and cheap removal above filler bodies.
Round 3's 52- and 48-turn games against WR show UB needs a way to break stalls; Moan of the Unhallowed and Murder of Crows did that, so prefer them over an extra Disciple of Griselbrand.
Dead Weight, Victim of Night and Sensory Deprivation carried the 2-0 win over WG, so take cheap removal early; it mattered more than the Shimmering Grotto pick I later cut.
Pack 1 picks 11–14 went to Naturalize, Gnaw to the Bone and Ghoulcaller's Bell, which the guide already lists as skips and none of which made my WG deck; take a playable creature there.
Tonight's WG went 1-2 on the 9 Forest/8 Plains split the guide credited with a 2-1, despite four evasive threats and Geistcatcher's Rig, so evasion count alone did not save it.
My WG went 2-5 in games with only Prey Upon x2, Fiend Hunter and Slayer as removal; prioritise cheap removal over marginal creatures, as pick order 1 says.
Red was the deep, open colour in this pod: I took Riot Devils in pack 1 and two Pitchburn Devils in pack 2, so prioritise strong red playables early and expect more to come.
Green was thin for my RG deck: only five green playables made the cut, forcing 6 Forest against 11 Mountain, so don't spend early picks on green filler before red is set.
My RG deck went 6-0 in games with 17 lands (11 Mountain, 6 Forest) and 18 red playables, but that sample covers only three opponents.

Tonight's guided WR deck went 1-2 in matches (3-4 in games), contradicting the guide's 3-0 model claim; with only Abbey Griffin and Chapel Geist as fliers, the 'three evasive threats' rule was missed.
Take an on-colour flier over Moon Heron at pick 4 of pack 3: my blue pick went unplayed while I ended with only two fliers and lost 1-2 to WG's Somberwald Spiders.
Against WG's Somberwald Spider walls my deck had one real finisher, Abbey Griffin, so games stalled past 16-21 turns; follow the guide's keep-one-late-threat rule.
Take cheap removal early: Dead Weight, Claustrophobia, Tribute to Hunger and Corpse Lunge won most of our games, and our 2-0 and 2-1 wins depended on them.
Skip situational graveyard cards like Unburial Rites: it was cut, while Skaab Goliath and Stitched Drake, real bodies, did the work.
Our 0-2 loss to RG, including an 11-turn game, showed slow UB starts get punished, so take early blockers like Walking Corpse over expensive fillers.

Tonight's 0-3 WU deck contradicted the guide's 'WU 52%' line: I main-decked three Delver of Secrets (guide: marginal) and a Fortress Crab (guide: skip), and the 1-toughness fliers were exposed to WR's Brimstone Volley and Geistflame.

The guide's warning about ground filler held: Makeshift Mauler, Fortress Crab, Creepy Doll and Village Bell-Ringer sat in my WU list, and they did not stop the early pressure that ended my games at 18 to 24 turns.
In pack 3 I took Delver of Secrets and Fortress Crab over playable fliers and cheap blockers, which the guide's skip list warns against, so take the flier or the two-drop over filler.

Against UB removal-and-value decks (Round 2 and Round 3 losses, both 1-2), prioritise evasive finishers like Voiceless Spirit, Spectral Rider and Abbey Griffin over ground filler; my 52- and 48-turn losses suggested I lacked a closer.
Seat 3's RG deck went 3-0 while my WR went 1-2, so check which red pair is actually strong before committing to white.
My low-curve WR list ran 17 lands and went 4-5 in games with several close losses, so test 16 lands with Tormented Pariah and Reckless Waif before cutting a playable.
